name: Depression
ability: Each night* choose a player (not yourself) not chosen before, they learn your alignment, if exiled you change alignments.
otherNightReminder: Depression points to a another player without a Cascades token. Place the Cascades token next to that player. Wake that player. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then the Depression token, and the good or evil card depending on the Depressions alignment.

name: Guilt
ability: Each night, choose an evil character, you learn if it is in play.
firstNightReminder: Guilt points towards an evil character. Nod 'yes' or shake head 'no' for whether it is in play.
otherNightReminder: Guilt points towards an evil character. Nod 'yes' or shake head 'no' for whether it is in play.

name: Anxiety
ability: Each night, you learn a character type (not Traveller) all alive Demons have as an alive neighbour.
firstNightReminder: Show Anxiety a character type token of a player the demon neighbours.
otherNightReminder: Show Anxiety a character type token of a player the demon neighbours.

name: Anger
ability: Each night, you learn a player and their alignment. They might think they have been affected by another ability.
firstNightReminder: Point to a player and give a thumbs up if good or a thumbs down if evil.
otherNightReminder: Point to a player and give a thumbs up if good or a thumbs down if evil.

name: Sadness
ability: Each night*, you learn a dead players character.
otherNightReminder: Show a character token of a dead player.

name: Grief
ability: Each night*, you learn if the player that died by execution yesterday neighbours the Demon.
otherNightReminder: If a player was executed today: Nod 'yes' or shake head 'no' for whether they neighbour the Demon.

name: Fear
ability: A player is drunk & gets false info. If they die, you learn the Demon.
otherNightReminder: If no one died in the night you die.

name: Disappointment
ability: You think you are a Minion, but you are not.

name: Boredom
ability: Your neighbours might wake to think they have been affected by another ability.

name: Happiness
ability: You start by choosing a player, they learn they have been chosen and can only win with you.
firstNightReminder: Happiness points to a player. Place the Happy token next to that player. Wake that player. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then the Happiness token.

name: Excitement
ability: Each night choose a player, they learn this, they get false information until dusk and if executed tomorrow their team loses.
firstNightReminder: Excitement points to a player. Place the Excited token next to that player. Wake that player. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then the Excitement token.
otherNightReminder: Excitement points to a player. Place the Excited token next to that player. Wake that player. Show the 'This character selected you' card, then the Excitement token.

name: Gratitude
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly guess all players characters, if correct your team wins. [+1 Outsider]

name: Love
ability: Each night, choose a player, the next night they die, You learn chosen minions characters instead. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
firstNightReminder: Love points to a player. That player is chosen. If a minion was chosen, you learn their character.
otherNightReminder: Love points to a player. If that player is not a minion they are chosen. The player chosen last night dies. If a minion was chosen, you learn their character.

name: Hope
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. Minions are secretly good. You are safe from other abilities. You start seeing the Grimoire. [+1 Minion]
otherNightReminder: Hope either shows a 'no' head signal, or points to a player. That player dies.

name: Faith
ability: Each night*, a player might die and 1 Faith learns another. You think you are a not in play good character, but you are not. If 3 players live and Faith is executed all are. [All Minions are Faith]
otherNightReminder: Choose a Faith player, show 'This player is' then the Faith token and point to another. Then choose a player, they die.

name: The spiral
ability: Evil Travelers don't learn the demon and can't die at night.
